parameters.query:
WITH archived AS (
  DELETE FROM ops.workflow_audit
  WHERE id IN (
    SELECT id FROM ops.workflow_audit
    WHERE started_at < '{{ $json.cutoff }}'::timestamptz
    ORDER BY started_at ASC
    LIMIT {{ $json.batchSize }}
  )
  RETURNING *
)
INSERT INTO ops.workflow_audit_archive
  (id, workflow_name, workflow_id, execution_id, channel, status, started_at,
   completed_at, duration_ms, tenant_id, correlation_id, error_message,
   metadata_json, created_at, archived_at)
SELECT id, workflow_name, workflow_id, execution_id, channel, status, started_at,
       completed_at, duration_ms, tenant_id, correlation_id, error_message,
       metadata_json, created_at, now()
FROM archived
RETURNING id
